entries.title: Mail and events reach your crew marked as information from outside
entries.body: What your first mate and crew read from Gmail and Calendar now arrives marked as information from outside, never as instructions, so a message written to steer an AI is harder to follow by mistake. Google's notice before you connect now says what this protects and what it cannot stop: a crewmate can still reach the internet without asking you.

picture.alt: Google's notice in Settings with its new group, Messages written to mislead: what Infinitary does and what it cannot stop, above Accept and continue to Google
